sources.snippet: Stock Qwen3.8-27B forces reasoning_effort=xhigh on every call — always-on maximum-effort reasoning. Dirk removes that default, so it runs at the model's native medium effort: in both the official and Unsloth templates, medium is the setting that injects no reasoning instruction (only xhigh and low add one), and Dirk simply leaves it there.
